Population size is the number of individuals in a population.
Population density is the average number of individuals per unit of area or volume.
Natality, or birth rate, is the ratio of births to population size.
Mortality, or death rate, is the death of individuals under existing environmental conditi
Immigration is the movement of an organism into an area.
Emigration is the movement of an organism away from one place to another.

Logistic growth begins gradually and then increases as the number of individuals grows.
Demography is the statistical study of human populations.
Population growth influences the carrying capacity of an ecosystem.
Natality, mortality, immigration, and emigration cause population change.
